problem: Pretrain-then-adapt VLAs are pretrained on static internet data and lack intrinsic physical grounding, which leads to fragmentation between navigation and manipulation and to catastrophic forgetting of general reasoning when the model is fine-tuned for motor skills.
motivation: Generalist robots need representations that are both semantically rich and physically actionable. The paper argues embodied sensorimotor data should be a first-class citizen from the earliest training stages, alongside web and driving data. Joint VLM and action-expert training also erodes the semantic knowledge the VLM already holds.
key_idea: Train an embodied-native VLA on mixed web, driving and embodied data across three stages (pre, mid, post), using a gradient-insulated flow-matching action expert and hierarchical spatial CoT scaffolding (subtask, goal box, EEF trace, action tokens).
insight: The paper claims that unified multi-source pretraining plus insulated action gradients gives a compact 2B model strong manipulation results, and that it keeps VQA ability. There are no ablations, so the contribution of each component (hybrid gradient, scaffolding, embodied pretraining) is not isolated. The evidence is only benchmark comparison against baselines and qualitative VQA examples.
method: Architecture: Qwen3-1.7B LLM plus Perception Encoder (728x728 multi-view images, 4x downsampling with two stride-2 3x3 convs), and a flow-matching action expert conditioned on the VLM KV cache; about 2B parameters in total.

Pretraining: single stage, all parameters trained, on 1.2T tokens (370K steps, batch 8192, length 4096) of web, education, OCR, grounding/counting, VQA, GUI, driving and embodied grounding/caption data; two-phase LR schedule with a higher-quality mix in the last 300B tokens.

Hybrid gradient (Knowledge Insulation style): action-expert gradients are not backpropagated to the VLM on embodied data, the VLM keeps training on non-embodied data, and the VLM also predicts discrete action tokens (255-bin, horizon 50) with a CE loss; total loss = λ·L_AR + L_FM, λ=1.

Embodied Spatial Scaffolding: hierarchical auxiliary prediction of subtask, goal bounding box, 2D end-effector trajectory, then discrete actions, used as spatial CoT that constrains the action space; inference can go directly to actions or through reasoning text first.

Mid-training: one epoch on 200M samples of cross-embodiment robot data (OXE, Fuse, RoboMind, AgiBot, Galaxea, self-collected), sim data (LIBERO, RoboTwin2.0, Habitat navigation), embodied reasoning QA and filtered VL data, with 500 conversation templates per scenario, on 64 H20 GPUs.

Post-training / SFT: narrows to target embodiments (50M samples); Specialist SFT per task (40K-150K iterations, progress supervision on repetitive tasks) and Generalist SFT on all tasks per robot (200K iterations).

setting.backbone: Qwen3-1.7B + Perception Encoder VLM with flow-matching action expert (trained; ~2B)
setting.training_data: 1.2T-token multimodal pretraining (web, education, OCR, grounding, GUI, driving, embodied), 200M-sample mid-training (cross-embodiment robot, sim, ER, VL), 50M-sample post-training, then task-specific SFT on RoboChallenge data
setting.observation: multi-view RGB (3 views) + proprioceptive state + language instruction
setting.action_space: continuous action chunks (horizon 50) via flow matching; discrete 255-bin tokens for the VLM
setting.simulator: real world only (RoboChallenge); LIBERO, RoboTwin2.0 and Habitat used only as training data

numbers.extra: per-task SFT (specialist); some tasks use progress supervision; data reported before 20260210
single multi-task SFT model per robot platform, 200K iterations; data reported before 20260210

numbers_note: Not a navigation benchmark result; RoboChallenge Table30 is real-world tabletop manipulation. No navigation numbers are reported despite the claim of unifying navigation. Split labeled 'test' by assumption.
results: DM0-Specialist reaches 62.00% average SR on Table30, above GigaBrain-0.1 (51.67%), Spirit-v1.5 (51.00%) and pi0.5 (42.67%). DM0-Generalist reaches 37.3 SR / 49.08 score versus pi0.5-generalist 17.67/31.27.
limitations: No ablations isolate hybrid gradient, scaffolding or embodied pretraining; multimodal understanding is only shown qualitatively.
Navigation is claimed as unified but not evaluated; only tabletop manipulation on RoboChallenge is reported.
Small model (2B), and very long-horizon tasks remain hard; several tasks score 0.
